task_b: Delegate Markup construction for HTML-aware objects through escape.
merge_result: Patch A and Patch B apply cleanly to the same base commit with git apply; no textual conflict is reported.
failure_summary: Patch A makes escape prefer __html_format__("") over __html__ when both are present. Patch B makes Markup construction delegate HTML-aware objects through escape. Together, Markup(obj) changes from using obj.__html__() to using obj.__html_format__(""), violating the constructor's established HTML protocol contract.
notes: Third MarkupSafe seed instance. It targets protocol precedence between __html__, __html_format__, escape, and Markup construction.
